project.name: UltimateGuitar
project.summary: Reliable sample-based metal guitar VST3 using the current Palm Mute / Downstroke / Middle Left/Right recordings.
project.firstRelease: Windows x64 VST3 v0.1 with four strict string zones and Left/Right performance banks

ui.componentStrategy: iPlug2 IGraphics primitives behind UltimateGuitar-owned layout, tokens and control contracts
ui.accessibilityTarget: keyboard-operable controls, visible focus, high-contrast states and correct 100-150% Windows/FL Studio scaling
ui.visualRegression: UI-contract tests plus current screenshots at Ready/Problem and supported scaling before release

experience.audience: DAW users who should not need SFZ or developer knowledge
experience.installer: NSIS Windows installer; one UAC elevation for FL Studio system VST3 and shared sample content
experience.onboarding: automatic sample discovery; no wizard when the bundled bank is healthy
experience.updater: not-applicable in v0.1; reinstall a newer signed/versioned candidate
experience.recovery: friendly library Problem state with Locate Sample Library; raw diagnostics stay secondary
experience.reset: remove or replace per-user sampleRoot setting; product samples remain untouched
experience.uninstaller: remove only product-owned VST3/shared sample content and preserve per-user settings
goldenJourneys: Install -> FL Studio verified scan -> plugin Ready -> first mapped note plays
Returning project -> saved controls/seed restore -> deterministic playback
Missing/incompatible library -> Problem -> Locate Sample Library -> Ready
Uninstall -> product-owned files removed -> reinstall -> Ready without touching raw recordings

release.deployment: Windows install to Program Files/Common Files/VST3 plus ProgramData/UltimateGuitar/Samples/v0.1
release.rollback: uninstall candidate and reinstall previous versioned candidate; never modify raw recordings
